subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should this first server-side board release support MCP-app widgets now, and if so which authorized descriptor/render contract should clients and the dashboard tool use?
rationale: The remaining blocker is a durable public gateway and agent-tool contract, not a mechanical omission that can safely be selected by repair automation.

options.title: Complete the unified widget contract
options.body: Add an agent-facing widget creation/update action and an authorized renderable MCP-app contract, with protocol and live gateway proof.

options.title: Ship HTML-only boards first
options.body: Remove or defer the MCP-app board variant and document the narrowed initial contract until a dedicated renderer is approved.

options.title: Pause for contract review
options.body: Hold the branch until the dashboard, MCP-app, and native-client owners agree on the permanent representation.

recommendation.title: Complete the unified widget contract
recommendation.body: Add an agent-facing widget creation/update action and an authorized renderable MCP-app contract, with protocol and live gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged adjacent board-view work and this branch place the dashboard contract history with this contributor.
